blocks.tamil_translation: a man was swimming. On the river bank a man had gathered a great many stones beside him. The one swimming would swim towards him and open his mouth, and the man on the bank would throw a stone into his mouth. Because of that he went off (far away). Then, swimming, he came back again to the same man. Every time he came to the man standing on the bank he would open his mouth, and he would throw a stone into it. I asked these two angels, "Who are those two?" The two angels said, "Go on! Go on ahead!' Then, when we went on ahead, we passed by the ugliest-looking man of all the men you have seen. Beside him a fire was burning. He was kindling it and running around it. When I asked them, "Who is this man?" they said, "Go further on ahead." Then we reached a lush green", flower garden full of every kind of flower. In the middle of that garden there was a tall man. Because he was so very tall, it was difficult for me to see his head. All around him there were a great many children. I had never seen so many children before this. When I asked, "Who is he? Who are these children?" they said, ''Go on ahead." Then we went on and reached a large garden. I had never seen such a large, beautiful garden before this. They told me to climb up into it. We climbed up into it and reached a city built with one brick of gold and one brick of silver. We reached the gate of the city and asked for the door to be opened; the door was opened and we entered that city. There we met men, the like of whom you have never seen anywhere, with half of their body handsome and half of their body ugly. The two angels
